title: Recording, mixing: Suicide, London Town, Girls School by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Work resumed on the London Town album on 8 March 1977, following a three-week break.

The session, however, began with Paul McCartney recording a demo of ‘Suicide’. He had written the song in 1956, and had always envisaged Frank Sinatra singing it. After seeing Sinatra perform at London’s Royal Albert Hall on 4 March, he decided to revive the song, recording a demo with vocals, piano, bass guitar, and percussion.

McCartney also added an organ overdub to the song ‘London Town’. He then oversaw stereo mixes of both songs and ‘Girls School’, as well as a studio Wings jam.
